blurb: The NFC & SE Platform allows developers to deploy custom Secure Element applets for NFC-based transactions, with a mandatory security review pipeline before device deployment. Applets must pass evaluation by an accredited third-party security laboratory and Apple review before being signed and hosted for installation. Each applet is installed in an isolated Security Domain preventing inter-applet data access. Transaction authorization requires biometric or passcode authentication gated through the Secure Enclave, with transaction data routed exclusively through the NFC controller to the Secure Element – never exposed to the application processor or iOS.
